back: A business owned and usually run by one person, who keeps all the profit and has unlimited liability.
A business owned by two or more people who share capital, work, profit and risk, usually under a partnership agreement.
A business owned and run by its members, with one member one vote and profit shared among members.
An owner is responsible for all the business's debts, including from personal property.
A written document setting capital, duties, profit shares and what happens when a partner leaves; without one, profit is normally shared equally.
Total control, keeps all profit, few formalities, close contact with customers.
Unlimited liability, limited finance, heavy workload, business may end with the owner.
More capital and skills, shared workload; but unlimited liability, disagreements and shared profits.
Producer (sell members' produce together), consumer (buy goods together) and worker (members run the business).
